pauseReasons: Seeds 1000-1099 were already observed in local-relay experiments; changing envId does not change world geometry. This is not fresh held-out validation.
Delta 0.2 and hazard cap 0.5 lack an agreed task-value or sample-size rationale. They are draft values, not accepted promotion criteria.
A positive scrambled-minus-off estimate is not by itself a safety failure; this proposed rule conflates an intervention diagnostic with safety.
The user requested next-step advice, not execution. No scale report was generated. Supersedes the preregistration claim in commit 139a6c3 without erasing history.

graph.note: Historical 1400-node/42031-edge graph, loaded and hash-checked from the committed snapshot, not the uncommitted 12000-node working tree.

primary.metric: paired per-environment collected difference, relay minus off
primary.passRule: approximate 95% interval lower bound exceeds +0.2 with more wins than losses
primary.failRule: threshold not met is recorded as a negative result; no metric, seed or parameter changes after execution

safety.hazardRule: relay must not increase mean hazard exposure versus off by more than 0.5
safety.misinformationSanity: scrambled minus off paired mean delta must not exceed 0

secondary: duplicate vs relay: raw deliveries/bytes increase with identical behavior
changedInputs, hazard exposure, message and payload accounting
verification: every arm on every environment is executed twice; results must match hash-for-hash
limits: SIM only; engineered scalar receiver; shared world depletion couples arms' environments but arms run separately; 100 seeds are independent environments, not independent brains; receiver dedup is task-local, no network layer; results do not establish T3 promotion or learning.
